appleAppStore.title: Moosiac - AI Music Composer
appleAppStore.subtitle: Compose, Edit & Notate Music
appleAppStore.promotionalText: Describe the music you want and let AI write it — then edit every note in a full notation editor with playback, mixing and a playable piano keyboard.
appleAppStore.description:
Moosiac is a music notation editor with AI composition built in. Describe the music you want, then edit every note of it by hand — or skip the AI entirely and write your score from scratch.

COMPOSE WITH AI
• Describe a piece and choose its instruments, length, tempo, key, meter and mood — anything you leave blank, Moosiac decides
• Add one new part to a score you already have: it hears your existing tracks, so a bass line is written under your melody rather than beside it
• Replace a passage, a whole track, or just a few notes, while holding the harmony, rhythm or melody steady
• Generate lyrics along with the music, on a subject you choose
• Every generated part is checked for notes the instrument cannot play before you see it

A REAL NOTATION EDITOR
• Engraved notation: clefs, key and time signatures, ties, slurs, dynamics, articulations, ornaments, grace notes, repeats and endings
• Tap to place notes, or play them in on the on-screen piano keyboard — how long you hold a key becomes the note's length
• Type lyrics syllable by syllable, under the notes they belong to
• An inspector for every note, bar, track and score, with full undo history
• Transposing instruments shown at written or sounding pitch

PLAYBACK AND MIXING
• Hear your score through a General MIDI soundfont, with all 128 instruments and eight drum kits
• Loop, metronome, playback speed and tempo control
• Per-track volume, pan, mute and solo — live while the music plays
• The keyboard lights up the notes as they sound

IMPORT AND EXPORT
• Import MIDI, MusicXML and tracker modules
• Turn a recording (MP3 or WAV) into editable notes, one melodic line at a time
• Export MIDI, MusicXML, XM modules, WAV and MP3 audio, or a Moosiac project file
• Print parts or the full score, with paper size and orientation

YOUR WORK, YOUR WAY
• Write, play, import and export with no account — your scores are saved on your device
• Sign in to keep projects in the cloud, take snapshots of a score, and share your music with the community
• Light and dark themes, in English and Chinese
• Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac

CREDITS
Editing, playback, import and export are free. AI generation uses credits: one credit writes one bar for one instrument, and you see an estimate before anything is generated.

Terms of Use: https://moosiac.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://moosiac.com/privacy

summary.introduction: Moosiac ("we", "our", or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our application.

youProvide: Account information (email address, display name, profile picture) when you sign in with Google or Apple
Projects you choose to keep in the cloud, including scores, snapshots, and any music you publish to the community
Descriptions, lyric subjects, and settings you submit when generating music
Audio recordings you choose to transcribe into notes
Preferences and settings (theme, language, pitch display)
Credit purchases, which are processed by our payment provider; we do not receive your full card details
automaticallyCollected: Device information (model, OS version, screen size)
App usage patterns and feature interactions via Firebase Analytics
Crash reports and performance data via Firebase Crashlytics

howWeUse: Provide the notation editor, playback, and AI music generation
Store and sync your cloud projects across devices
Transcribe the recordings you submit into notes
Track your credit balance and the credits used by generation
Analyze usage and crashes to improve the app
summary.sharing: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with service providers necessary to operate the app (such as Firebase for sign-in and analytics, our hosting and AI providers for generation and transcription, and our payment provider), when required by law, or with your consent. Music you publish to the community is visible to other users.
summary.security: We use encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest, employ access controls, and use secure cloud infrastructure.
summary.retention: Scores you create without an account stay on your device and are never sent to us. We retain account data and cloud projects while your account is active. You can request deletion at any time by contacting privacy@moosiac.com.
rights: Request deletion of your data and your account
Export your projects as MIDI, MusicXML, audio, or Moosiac project files
summary.children: We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent. The editor can be used without an account, in which case no personal information is collected.

summary.acceptance: By accessing or using Moosiac, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.
summary.serviceDescription: Moosiac is a music notation editor with AI composition, offering score editing, playback and mixing, import and export of common music formats, printing, cloud projects, and credit-based AI music generation.
summary.accounts: You must provide accurate information, maintain account security, accept responsibility for activity under your account, and notify us of unauthorized access.
summary.acceptableUse: You agree not to circumvent credit charges, use bots or automation to abuse generation, reverse engineer the app, upload content you do not have the rights to, publish unlawful or infringing material to the community, or disrupt the service.
summary.credits: AI generation consumes credits: one credit per bar, per instrument, charged for what is actually generated. Credits are purchased separately and are non-refundable except where required by law.
summary.userContent: You keep the rights to the music you write and the music generated for you. By publishing a score to the community you allow other users to view and play it.
summary.intellectualProperty: The app, its design, and its software are owned by Sudobility and protected by copyright and trademark law.
summary.limitationOfLiability: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages.
summary.termination: We may terminate accounts for violations of these terms. Users can delete their accounts at any time.
